verbetes.glosa_atual: [Fonte em inglês; tradução pendente] (מָסַר) informer, traitor (delivering Jews into the hands of the Roman government).
definicoes_originais: (מָסַר) informer, traitor (delivering Jews into the hands of the Roman government).
notas_originais: B. Kam. 119 a ממון מ' the property of an informer. Ker. 2 b; B. Kam. 5 a Ms. M. (ed. מוסר, corr. acc.); a. fr.— Pl. מְסוֹרוֹת. Y. Sot. IX, end, 24 c, a. e. מפני המ' (studying Greek was forbidden) on account of the informers (whose familiarity with Greek tempted them to treason, v. Bab. ib. 49 b). R. Hash. 17 a המינין והמ' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50) the heretics and the informers.— Fem. מָסוֹרָה. Midr. Till. to Ps. XII תהא אומתך מ' לך (ed. Bub. אומתיה מסיראה, corr. acc.) may thy own people turn informer against thee; Yalk. verbetes.glosa_atual: [Fonte em inglês; tradução pendente] (מָסַר) ( a chain of) tradition.
notas_originais: Sot. 10 b דבר זה מ' בידינו מאבותינו וכ' we hold a tradition from our fathers that &c. Ḥull. 63 b עוף טהור נאכל במ' as for eating clean birds we rely on tradition (there being no rules for distinguishing them in the Biblical law).—Esp. the traditional Scriptural text without vowels, contrad. to מקרא the traditional vocalization, v. אֵם. Y. Meg. IV, 74 d bot. (ref. to Neh. VIII, 8) ‘they explained the reading’, זה המ' this means the traditional text; Bab. ib. 3 a אלו המסורות (some eds. מסורת; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.); Ned. 37 b המסורות. Ab. III, 13 מ' סייג לתורה the tradition is the fence for (preserving the integrity of) the Torah. Zeb. 37 b, sq. אהני מקרא ואהני מ' the traditional vocalization is a help (in interpretation), and so is the traditional literal text (e. g. בסכת, Lev. XXIII, 42, which may be interpreted as singular number, and which is read as a plural); a. fr.— Pl. מַסֹּורֹות. Tanḥ. Vaëthḥ. 6 נטלו מ' חכמה וכ' the traditions of wisdom were taken from Moses and given to Joshua.—Meg. 3 a; Ned. 37 b, v. supra.—[מַסֹּורָה Massorah, the collection of textual readings systematically arranged.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: [Fonte em inglês; tradução pendente] (נְסַח); = מְסָחָא balance, pair of scales.; weighing counter, esp. butcher’s stall.
notas_originais: Targ. Ps. LXII, 10.— Pl. מִסְחָאתָא. Targ. Job VI, 2 ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. מְסַחְתָּא). Ib. XXXI, 6 מסאחתא Ms. (corr. acc.; ed. מְשַׁחְתָּא). Targ. Y. Deut. XXV, 15 (not מִסְחַאֲ').

Ḥull. 132 b קבע מ' he put up a permanent stall for selling meat. Shebu. 42 a איתיבת אמ' וכ' you sat by the stall and took your (advanced) money as the meat was being sold. B. Kam. 23 b תיב אמ' וכ' (sell your animal to the butcher, and) sit by the stall and get your money (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [Fonte em inglês; tradução pendente] (Ithpe. noun of סבב) = אִיסְטֵיב, porch, esp. dealer’s stall with a bench attached to the house.
definicoes_originais: (Ithpe. noun of סבב) = אִיסְטֵיב, porch, esp. dealer’s stall with a bench attached to the house.
notas_originais: Y. B. Bath. II, beg. 13 b זבין … ושייר בה חד מ' sold his dwelling and reserved for himself one porch.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [Fonte em inglês; tradução pendente] same.
notas_originais: Cant. R. to VI, 12 אין הוא מסתכל לההיא מ' וכ' (not לההוא) if he looks up to that stall where he used to sit tailoring &c.— Pl. מִסְטֹובְיָיתָא. Y. Bets. I, 60 c bot. לא … על מ' ברייתא וכ' sit not on the outer benches of the hall of Bar Ula, for they are cold.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [Fonte em inglês; tradução pendente] (cmp. אִיסְטְוָוא, אִיסְטֵיו).
notas_originais: Y. Kil. IX, 32 a נתון ע"ג מ' placed on a stationary stone bench, opp. מיטה, couch. Y. Erub. VII, 24 b bot. עשה מ' על פני וכ' (not עשרה) if he attached a porch along the whole front of the wall.— Pl. מִסְטְוָיֹות. Y. Pes. V, 32 c bot. מ' היו עושין להון they made for them projecting boards (along the wall, that they should not step on the blood; Bab. ib. 65 b דמסגי אאיצטבי, v. אִיסְטְבָא).

verbetes.glosa_atual: [Fonte em inglês; tradução pendente] (סָטַר) a blow, slap.
notas_originais: Tanḥ. Ḥayé 3 סטרו מ' he slapped him in the face; a. e.; v. מִסְטָר.— Pl. מִסְטֹורִין. Yalk. Koh. 968 (play on אף, Koh. II, 9) תורה שלמדתי באף נתקיימה לי … שלמדתי במ' היא עמדה לי the lesson which I learned with ‘heat’ remained to me; … the very lesson which I learned with (my teachers’) slaps stood by me; Koh. R. to l. c. כל תורה שלמדתי בזקנתי פסטירין באף נתקיימה לי (corr. acc.; v. Matt. K. a. l.).

definicoes_originais: (סְטֵי) one who diverts judgment from its straight path (= h. מַטֵּה דִין), prevaricator.
notas_originais: Targ. Is. LVIII, 6 דין מ' (h. text מוֹטָה).—Gen. R. s. 50 (fictitious name of a Sodomite judge) רב מַסְטֵידִין (= מַסְטֵי דין, some ed. מסטירין, corr. acc.) Chief Prevaricator (Snh. 109 b מצלי דינא); Yalk. ib. 84 (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: [Fonte em inglês; tradução pendente] sing.
notas_originais: a. pl. (μυστήριον, -α) secret. Midr. Till. to Ps. IX, 6 מיסטורין זה אני וכ' ed. Bub. (ed. מסתורין, corr. acc.) this secret I reveal to thee. Gen. R. s. 50; s. 68 ע"י שגלו מ' וכ' because they revealed the mysteries of the Lord (Gen. XIX, 13); Yalk. ib. 84 מסתורין. Gen. R. s. 71 בעלי מ' secret-keeping, discreet men. Ib. s. 98; Tanḥ. Vayḥi 8; Pesik. R. s. 21 מסטירים (corr. acc.). Y. Gitt. II, 44 b top כתב מ' a secret letter; (Y. Sabb. XII, end, 13 d מילה מסטריקון); a. fr.—Targ. Y. I Gen. XXVIII, 12 מַסְטִירִין (some ed. מַסְתִּי', corr. acc.). Targ. Y. Num. XVI, 26 מְסַטְּרִין (some ed. מַסְטְרִין, corr. acc.).—[Gen. R. s. 50; Yalk. ib. 84, v. מַסְטֵי.]

notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 15 סטרו מ', סטרן מ', v. מִסְטוֹר. Num. R. s. 20, end נתן מִשְׂטָר אחד וכ' he slapped one of the boys; (Tanḥ. ed. Bub. Balak 30, note 175 מסטר).—V. מִסְטוֹר.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [Fonte em inglês; tradução pendente] (b. h.) to melt, flow; to cause running off, effect curdling.; to cause to flow.; same, to dissolve, weaken.; to be melted, to fall away.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) to melt, flow; to cause running off, effect curdling.
to be melted, to fall away.
notas_originais: Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 25 שלא יִמְסֶה that the manna might not melt.—Denom. מְסוֹ.
Ib. to Ps. VI, 7 התחיל בוכה ומַמְסֶה מטתו וכ' ed. Bub. (ed. וממחה) he began to weep and make his bed flow with (his) tears; Yalk. Ps. 636.
Deut. R. s. 7 (play on מַסּוֹת, Deut. XXIX, 2) המכות מְמַסּוֹת גופיהן וכ' the plagues weakened the bodies of the Egyptians; Yalk. ib. 940.
Tosef. Sot. III, 4 ירכה נִמְסֵית her thigh will fall away.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [Fonte em inglês; tradução pendente] , to flow, melt away.; to cause melting, falling away.; to be melted, fall away.; same.
notas_originais: Targ. II Sam. XVII, 10 מִמַס יִמְסֵי (ed. Wil. יַמְסֵי Af.), v. מְסַס.—Part. מָסֵי, f. מַסְיָא. Targ. O. Num. V, 21 (ed. Vienna מַסְּיָא = מְמַסְּיָא, v. infra).
Targ. Ps. XXXIX, 12 מַסְּיַת. Targ. Y. Num. V, 22 למַסְיָא = למְמַסְיָא.—Part. pass. מְמַסָּא, מְמַסֵּי, f. (מְ)מַסְּיָא, v. supra. Pes. 28 a Rashi לא מְמַסָּה is not dissolved in water, v. מְאִיס.
same. Targ. O. Num. l. c.; a. e.—Targ. II Sam. l. c., v. supra.
Targ. Num. V, 27. Targ. O. Lev. XXVI, 39 (v. יְמַס); a. fr.—Targ. Y. Gen. VII, 21 אִתְהַמְסִי (not אתח'; h. text ויגוע).
Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 6 Ms., v. מְאִיס. Ib. LXVIII, 3 Ms. (ed. Ithpe.); a. fr. (in Ms.).

definicoes_originais: (a popular corruption of semissis) semissis, a Roman value, equal to half an as or six ounces.
notas_originais: Tosef. B. Bath. V, 12 מי' שני קונטרונין a semissis is equal to two quadrantes; Kidd. 12 a מסמס שני קוטרונקין; Y. ib. I, 58 d שני קרדיונטס מסי'.— Pl. מְסִימִיסִין, מִיסְמְסִין, מוּסְמִיסִין. Tosef. l. c. איסר שני מיס' an as has two semisses; Kidd. l. c. מוסמי'; Y. l. c. מסומיסין.
